propositions: review_interrupts metric is dimensionless and cannot distinguish between bound-exceeded and signal-unavailable causes, forcing operators to use host shell access to diagnose the reason
bound-exceeded and signal-unavailable require opposite remediations and cannot both be addressed by the same alarm threshold or sensitivity tuning

split review_interrupts into two separate dimensionless metrics (review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable) while retaining the rolled-up review_interrupts for historical continuity
replace the single review_interrupts alarm with two reason-scoped alarms, each with only its own remediation in the description, keeping signal-unavailable alarming on single-datapoint latching

observability.sh reuses the existing publish_autodeploy_marker_delta helper with new offset files to count journal patterns by reason, and monitoring_autodeploy.tf replaces the alarm with two new alarms
